s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Drive Shaft Inboard Joint Boot Clamp LH NO.2

s2.ptxt: Using needle-nose pliers, release the hook portion and remove the clamp.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Drive Shaft Inboard Joint Boot Clamp LH

s2.ptxt: Using a screwdriver, release the staking of the inboard joint boot clamp and disconnect the clamp.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Drive Shaft Inboard Joint Boot

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the inboard joint boot from the rear drive shaft inboard joint assembly LH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Drive Shaft Inboard Joint Assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Remove the grease from the inboard joint.
Put matchmarks on the inboard joint assembly and outboard joint shaft assembly.

atten3.ptxt: Do not use a punch to make the matchmarks.

s2.ptxt: Secure the outboard joint shaft assembly in a vise between aluminum plates.
Using SST, remove the shaft snap ring.
Put matchmarks on the tripod joint and outboard joint shaft assembly.

atten3.ptxt: Do not use a punch to make the matchmarks.

s2.ptxt: Using a brass bar and hammer, remove the tripod joint assembly.
Remove the inboard joint boot clamp No.2 and inboard joint boot.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Drive Shaft Inboard Joint Snap Ring LH

s2.ptxt: Using a screwdriver, remove the snap ring.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Drive Shaft Dust Cover LH

s2.ptxt: Using SST and a press, remove the dust cover.
